quests.title: Just Like Old Times

dialogue.t: Well, this is one for the books. Never thought I'd see the day when you'd invite me to one of your tea parties, Sandrone.
Perhaps if you'd worked on your etiquette, I would have invited you over sooner.
I agree. It might also help your case if you stopped challenging people to duels all the time.
Heh. You sound exactly like my big brothers and sisters. I can't help it. Back when my master was training me in the wild, etiquette wasn't exactly a priority.
Forget it. It's not often we manage to get together. Let's just relax and enjoy the moment.
Hmm. Is this your latest creation?
Her name is Fagio. It stands for "Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache."
Does this mean Pulonia is really beyond repair...? I'm sorry to hear that, Sandrone.
It's fine, I...
...I'm sorry to hear that I'll never get the chance to fight him.
Of course you are...
Pulonia looked strong, but this "Fagio" on the other hand...
...Were you about to say she looks weak?
Uhm... Haha, no, no. It's just that she doesn't look quite as strong as Pulonia.
Hmph. Pulonia was built for measurements and calculations. I was careful not to compromise his processing power when giving him combat capabilities.
But Fagio doesn't need to process complex formulas. All of her computing power can be devoted to her combat module.
So... That means she's actually stronger than Pulonia? Is that even possible...?
You really won't be satisfied without a demonstration, will you?
Just so we're clear, I'm not paying for any repairs if I break her.
And I won't be paying your hospital bill.
(*sigh*... I knew this would happen.)
(*nom nom*...)
Not bad, these tea parties, all in all. If I'd known they were this much fun, I would've attended one sooner.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Alright, see you next time!

quests.description: Go to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests…
